title: PDF reports
summary: Reading report files with a template and embedding them in the message sent on.

sections.title: The template
paragraphs: A PDF report source reads report files, one message per file. Its template (a JSON object) lists the fields to read: the label on the report and whether the value is right of it or below. Start from the newborn screening preset.
A value missing from the report is empty. A report whose labels do not match is stored invalid with the reason and nothing is sent; correct the template and resend it as a new message.

Test with a PDF, under the template, reads a report you choose and shows the fields and the message a destination would get; nothing is stored or sent. On an invalid report, Test against the current template reads it again.
In the message detail, a stored report's Text view is the text read from it, page by page, with <HT> between phrases; Hex shows the file. Fields lists the values the channel's template reads.

sections.title: Folders and embedding
paragraphs: On the folder or SFTP endpoint, under After a file is read, a filtered and an unreadable reports folder keep left-out and unreadable reports apart. A mapping embeds the report with report.file_base64; an HL7 v2 files destination writes each message as a file for the receiver to collect.
